documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Brandman Retail Limited held its H2 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 20, 2026, discussing its financial and operational performance, store expansion plans, and retail strategy. Management highlighted robust financial growth, including a CAGR of 84.46% on EBITDA and a top-line figure of ₹162 Cr with a PAT margin of 15.55%. The company plans to aggressively expand its retail presence in second-tier and third-tier cities through its owned multi-brand sneaker stores and exclusive brand outlets. Furthermore, management noted that store expansion will be funded via IPO proceeds, while the B2B segment is expected to take a back seat in favor of direct-to-consumer and retail growth. Brandman Retail Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in revenue to ₹16,240.87 Lakhs and a strong EBITDA margin of 22.82%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian consumer is maturing into wanting branded products, good quality research products, and brand association at the right price.
demand_outlook.quote: I feel that the Indian consumer is now maturing into wanting branded product, wanting to have an experience of good quality researched product, and wanting to be associated with the brand at the right price.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the 22 new stores are being funded with the IPO money.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it is with the IPO money, ma'am.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that retail and e-commerce gross margins are around 50 to 54% or 54% plus, while B2B gross margins are around 50%.
margins_costs.quote: We have retail and e-commerce with gross margins of around 50 to 54%. B2B margins are slightly lower on gross margin part, as they go to wholesalers and export suppliers.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that in FY26, the advertisement cost in comparison to revenue is around 5 to 6% only.
margins_costs.quote: in FY26, our advertisement cost in comparison to revenue is around 5 to 6% only.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for FY 2025-26 reached ₹16,240.87 Lakhs with an EBITDA margin of 22.82%.
PAT for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, was reported at ₹2,529.42 Lakhs.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that products are available to consumers through marketplace channels in roughly 20,000 plus PIN codes.
orders_capacity.quote: Through marketplace channels, roughly 20,000 plus PIN codes, our products are available to consumers, where we are in partnership with Myntra, Tata CLiQ, Tata CLiQ Luxury, Flipkart, Amazon, and everybody.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that On Running is still looking to get the BIS approved and the approval is pending.
risks_headwinds.quote: It is pending for On Running. It is still pending for On Running. On Running is still looking to get the BIS approved.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an aspiration to open 50 stores of Sneaker in the next 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Yeah, we aspire to have 50 stores of Sneaker in the next 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a target to make the company a 500 crore business company.
management_commitments.quote: Now we are all focusing on how to make it a ₹500 Cr business company.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
